title: Currency Converter & Card Charge Comparison
description: Convert foreign amounts at Bank of Canada daily or annual average rates and compare a dated purchase with the amount charged to your card.

data_info.detail: Bank of Canada observations supply daily conversions and published annual CAD averages. Frankfurter supplies additional reference rates for the card comparison. Entered amounts stay local.
data_info.cadence: Daily rates on demand; annual table checked monthly
